parameters.prompt: Stop-motion claymation style: hand-sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, soft rounded chunky forms, bold simple shapes and a clean readable silhouette, saturated slightly chalky colors, from the same world as a gold, crimson and cream 19th-century clay opera house. Cute, toy-like, never creepy.
